changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Battleship', 'Hidden-fleet naval combat. Place your ships, then fire to sink the opponent fleet. Host-authoritative; only hit, miss, or sunk is revealed.', 'battleship', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'battleship');
INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Battleship', 'Two 10x10 grids. Place a fleet, then take turns firing until one fleet is sunk.', 'battleship', 'battleship', 1, '/api/assets/levels/battleship/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'battleship'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'battleship');

INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Go', 'The ancient game of Go (Weiqi/Baduk) on a 9x9 board. Surround territory and capture stones; the most points wins.', 'go', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'go');
INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Go', 'A 9x9 Go board. Place stones to capture and surround territory; two passes end the game.', 'go', 'go', 1, '/api/assets/levels/go/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'go'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'go');
